newsitem.title: USA: Lawter sees Q1 EPS below $0.15 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Lawter sees Q1 EPS below $0.15 estimates.

text.p: Lawter International Inc said Thursday it expects first quarter earnings to fall below most analysts' estimate of $0.15 a share.
Increasing strength in the dollar and increasing competition in Europe hurt sales margins in the quarter, the specialty chemical company said.

The company said it expected sales in the quarter to be slightly ahead of the 1996 quarter. Overall volume was up six percent in the quarter, but currency factors had an adverse effect on sales values, it said.
The company reported revenues of $49.4 million and earnings of $0.14 a share in the first quarter of 1996.

The consolidation of the acquisitions made in the fourth quarter of 1996 will be completed by the end of the first quarter and should begin to positively impact earnings in the second quarter, Lawter said. However, the adverse impact from currency rates and competitive pressures may continue.

Management still believes its basic policies, along with new product development and the efficient utilization of new plants, sets the base for increased sales and earnings as the year progresses and as underlying circumstances improve, the company said.
Results for the first quarter will be released on April 24, Lawter said.
Lawter shares were down 1/2 at 11 in afternon trade.
